request.deadline: 12 months; grant period begins after closure of the existing contract
deliverables: Maintain the protobuf specification, including protocol compatibility, versioning, and documentation.
Maintain official SDKs with dependency updates, performance improvements, and bug fixes.
Provide community support through issue triage, review of external contributions, ecosystem-feedback-driven enhancements, and public communication.
Upgrade UTxO RPC compatibility with AI-driven development workflows through AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, administered by Intersect on behalf of the vendor TxPipe
request.what: Fund UTxO RPC by TxPipe for 12 months of part-time maintenance and enhancement, including specification, SDK maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation resources.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, consisting of 525,000 ADA for UTxO RPC maintenance and enhancement plus a 15,750 ADA Intersect budget administration fee.
The project scope is a 12-month part-time maintainer for UTxO RPC after the existing contract closes, intended to provide uninterrupted maintenance coverage.
UTxO RPC defines common methods, data structures, and communication patterns using Protocol Buffers and provides SDKs for Rust, Go, Node.js, .NET, Haskell, and Python.
The proposer states that UTxO RPC has been adopted by Amaru, Dingo, and the Haskell Cardano node as a query interface.
The project maintains more than 10 repositories for the core specification, language SDKs, documentation, and provider integrations under the Apache 2.0 open-source license.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and links to voting and audit references.
The proposer states the requested amount does not breach the 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission, either alone or in aggregate.
TxPipe is stated to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.
Prior Intersect 2025 open-source maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC is stated to be on schedule.

Funds would be managed through Intersect's 2026 Treasury Reserve and Project-Specific Smart Contracts with multi-party admin, leadership, and external oversight committee authorization rules plus a public dashboard and on-chain verifiability.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for a 12-month UTxO RPC maintenance grant administered by Intersect for TxPipe, with stated open-source infrastructure benefits, prior adoption, Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, and smart-contract-based oversight.
